system.text:
Trolls typically have massive, craggy claws used for digging and tearing. They don’t often use their claws as a weapon, favoring the use of their stony fists to subdue prey. However if a Troll has another character in a Lock and chooses to do damage (rather than increase the Lock), add +1 Power to the damage of the attack due to the claws gouging into the victim.

Type: Dt. Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Troll common trait

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 513
